rv.q: Details: Forever Plaid is a very enjoyable night out packed into 90 minutes of non-stop entertainment by MadKap Productions at the Skokie Theatre, 7924 N. Lincoln Ave., Skokie, IL through June 29, 2025.
The music is memorable and the homage to the Ed Sullivan Show ( you have to be of a certain age to truly appreciate this).

cn.t: This nostalgic tribute to 1950s-60s boy bands delivers lively performances and zany charm, earning positive reviews as an endearing precursor to modern jukebox musicals.
